titles.en: The Deed Must Have a Death
titles.es: La obra debe tener una muerte
titles.pt: O Ato Precisa de uma Morte

summaries.en: On the internet's quiet vote for memory over personhood, and why inheritance—not credentials—is the real struggle, which requires first a verifiable death.
summaries.zh: 互联网悄然投票：记忆重于人格；而真正的角力在于继承而非资质，继承的前提，是先有一场可验证的死亡。
